faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Get answers to common questions about synthetic deer scent and CWD regulations.

faqs.q: Is synthetic deer scent legal in all states?
faqs.a: Yes. Odin's 100% synthetic formulations contain zero biological material, making them legal in all 50 states — even where natural urine is banned or restricted.

faqs.q: What is CWD and why does it matter for deer scent?
faqs.a: Chronic Wasting Disease (CWD) is a fatal prion disease affecting cervids. Research suggests prions can persist in deer urine and bodily fluids, which is why many states have restricted or banned natural urine products. Synthetic scents contain no biological material and pose zero CWD risk.

faqs.q: How long does Odin's synthetic scent last?
faqs.a: Laboratory testing shows 52% scent output remaining after 27 days of continuous air exposure. For best results, we recommend replacing every 30 days during hunting season.

faqs.q: Does rain affect synthetic scent beads?
faqs.a: Unlike natural urine that washes away or dilutes, Odin's polymer matrix pauses scent release when wet but resumes full performance when dry. The scent is bound to the polymer, not just applied to it.

faqs.q: What's the difference between synthetic and natural deer scent?
faqs.a: Natural deer urine varies by source animal, diet, health, and season — leading to inconsistent results. Synthetic scent uses identical molecular formulations every time, providing consistent, repeatable attraction without biological variation or disease risk.
Yes. Odin's scent beads use a USDA BioPreferred certified plant-based polymer that biodegrades naturally. No cleanup required, and no environmental contamination risk.

faqs.q: Do I need special permits to use synthetic deer scent?
faqs.a: No. Because Odin's products contain no biological material from cervids, no game farm certifications or special permits are required. They're treated the same as any non-regulated hunting accessory.

faqs.q: What types of synthetic scents does Odin offer?
faqs.a: Odin offers multiple synthetic formulations: Doe Estrus, Dominant Buck, Food scents (apple, acorn, peanut butter, cherry), Cover scents, Scrape Blend, and Earth. All use the same long-lasting polymer technology.
